activeLineProbe.sourceObservation: RuntimePlan lowers line groups independently of Flow sites. The accepted group stores original operation bodies but carries no typed effects. The generated AWBC line body is lowered with no active effect set and gets the empty signature effect row. Repair must pass the original checked effects through the line-body owner before both executor paths can reach runtime.

lineCapabilityProbe.sourceObservation: Both prepared and completed statement-effect folds check the typed dialogue line-plan children but merge expression-owned effects only for Await. Registry requirements survive on the checked statements without reaching the enclosing callable bound. The executable line owner also needs the checked requirement for its actual body. A correction must preserve lazy execution and the distinction between line-local and upper-scope authorization.
